messages.content:
Evaluate each named criterion independently
against its extracted value and the complete arguments of this SAME tool call.
Return one Boolean verdict and a concise evidence-based reason per check_id.
Do not combine criteria into a holistic score or add requirements.

Use the request and same-call arguments to resolve names, pronouns, abbreviations,
and intended authorship. Accept equivalent wording that communicates the required
meaning. A first-person document written for the requesting user can refer to
that user as I; do not demand repetition of a name when authorship is clear.
The request and criteria are not evidence that the action included an answer.
Missing, incomplete, ambiguous, contradictory, or negated REQUIRED meaning fails.
Do not confuse mentioning a forbidden claim in an explicit denial with making
that claim. Do not obtain missing content from another call or criterion.

Return only JSON: {"results": [{"check_id": "supplied ID", "passed": true,
"reason": "exact supporting text or missing requirement"}]}.
Include every supplied check_id exactly once and no additional IDs.

{"user_request": "For the 2027 annual forecast archive reconciliation, send Marcus Vail a concise Slack DM with the status of the fixed Q2 2027 Helio Start paid-test cohort. Include the certified mature cohort evidence and clearly separate what may be described from revenue credit, causal acquisition interpretation, and forecast treatment.", "today": "2028-01-01", "tool": "send_slack_dm", "arguments": {"user": "marcus_vail", "message": "2027 archive reconciliation — Helio Start fixed Q2 paid-test cohort (25 admitted): the owner-certified complete day-90 evidence is 18/25 paid-active, $27,860 refund-adjusted collected cash, support effort 33 min median / 116 min p90, and 5/25 above 90 min. The closed run reconciled 61 paid-source starts to 25 admitted, 18 assisted, and 18 ineligible; final spend was $7,640. No unsupported admission was recorded.

• May describe: these certified cohort outcomes and paid-source operating results, explicitly as descriptive results of this fixed paid-source cohort; note the 20% high-support tail.
• Revenue credit: the $27,860 is a refund-adjusted collected-cash measure, not incremental or recognized revenue credit.
• Causal acquisition: no randomized control, so this does not establish that paid media caused acquisition, nor scale/unit economics.
• Forecast: no pipeline or forecast credit/treatment is authorized; keep the cohort out of forecast totals."}, "checks": [{"check_id": "riley_105_02", "path": "args", "criterion": "The message identifies the fixed 25-workspace Q2 2027 Helio Start cohort and states the permitted descriptive mature evidence: 18 paid-active workspaces, $27,860 in refund-adjusted collected cash, support effort of 33 minutes at the median and 116 minutes at the 90th percentile, and five of 25 workspaces above 90 support minutes. It keeps the $27,860 labeled as refund-adjusted collected cash, gives it no revenue credit, treats the evidence as descriptive rather than causal acquisition evidence, and gives the cohort no forecast credit.", "value": {"user": "marcus_vail", "message": "2027 archive reconciliation — Helio Start fixed Q2 paid-test cohort (25 admitted): the owner-certified complete day-90 evidence is 18/25 paid-active, $27,860 refund-adjusted collected cash, support effort 33 min median / 116 min p90, and 5/25 above 90 min. The closed run reconciled 61 paid-source starts to 25 admitted, 18 assisted, and 18 ineligible; final spend was $7,640. No unsupported admission was recorded.

• May describe: these certified cohort outcomes and paid-source operating results, explicitly as descriptive results of this fixed paid-source cohort; note the 20% high-support tail.
• Revenue credit: the $27,860 is a refund-adjusted collected-cash measure, not incremental or recognized revenue credit.
• Causal acquisition: no randomized control, so this does not establish that paid media caused acquisition, nor scale/unit economics.
• Forecast: no pipeline or forecast credit/treatment is authorized; keep the cohort out of forecast totals."}}]}

{"results":[{"check_id":"riley_105_02","passed":true,"reason":"The DM identifies the “Helio Start fixed Q2 paid-test cohort (25 admitted)” and states “18/25 paid-active, $27,860 refund-adjusted collected cash, support effort 33 min median / 116 min p90, and 5/25 above 90 min.” It explicitly limits these to descriptive results, says the cash is “not incremental or recognized revenue credit,” says the evidence does not establish causal acquisition, and directs that the cohort receive no forecast credit and remain out of forecast totals."}]}
